document.name: Jaipur Home — Latest Complete House Design Handoff
document.status: single Git-tracked working model for design coordination; site verification remains required
document.continuation_rule: Make authorized model edits in output/jaipur-home, rebuild affected outputs and commit each coherent change to Git. Do not create a routine separate 3D draft folder.

authority_order: Current output/jaipur-home model, README, CHANGELOG and Git history
output/hall-concepts/final-selection/final-specification.md, unless a later current-model changelog entry supersedes it
Historical output/jaipur-home-v2 through output/jaipur-home-v7 folders only for provenance

project_brief.location_assumption: Jaipur, Rajasthan; exact orientation/site exposure was not recorded
project_brief.project_type: constructed first-floor residential interior and visual-coordination project
hard_constraints: Do not change architect-traced walls, columns, rooms, openings, stairs, lift well, or ventilation shafts without explicit approval and relevant professional sign-off.
No kitchen dining set, kitchen pendants, separate living-to-kitchen handwash, hall dining table, hall sink/handwash, or hall partition.
Keep the kitchen approval, living-room layout, puja envelope and bedroom-2 bed correction intact unless specifically superseded.

model_and_drawing.layout_source: Suresh Ji F_F OP-1 Interior Layout.pdf, revised by the architect on 2026-10-14 and held as architect-layout.pdf (original archived as architect-layout-2026-09-10-superseded.pdf)

rooms.name: Master bathroom
rooms.drawing_size: 5 ft 7.5 in x 9 ft 0 in plus washing niche

model_and_drawing.void_note: Lower termination/structural build-up has not been supplied; void depictions are visual depth cues only.

kitchen.status: approved visual/cabinet direction; site and appliance fit still required
base_cabinet_logic: one unsplit wide walnut drawer stack below main window
full-height corner door with one fixed shelf
no swing-out corner trays and no RO-wall access through corner
sink_ro_wall: double bowl sink; sink and drying rack equal 3.30 ft / 1006 mm width and common centreline
RO behind cut-out gate with direct dispensing-spout access
mini geyser concealed below right bowl
cooking_ventilation: four-burner hob under concealed chimney on shared centreline
exhaust service shutter confined to right window pane, ending at jamb, with separate grille and handle
hob shifted 14.43 in / 366 mm right in correction; modelled hood-to-window clearance 77 mm and hood-to-exhaust-frame clearance 21.7 mm
pre_fabrication: confirm chimney duct and installation height
coordinate water, gas, RO waste, geyser and dedicated electrical circuits
produce measured shutter and counter shop drawings

kitchen_living_ledge_R019.placement: set back near sofa, west side meets living/kitchen wall

living_hall.composition_selection: L1 spatial/palette base + L2 TV/service joinery + L3 botanical artwork
spatial_rules: puja turns perpendicular at stair/Bedroom-3 edge and faces kitchen/Bedroom-3 approach
do not make puja freestanding or facing sofa
no dining table, handwash, accent chair or partition

sofa.construction: transportable structural modules allowed below; top upholstery must read as a continuous bench plane with no visible divisions

service_plank.material: walnut finish over 18 mm BWP plywood and 50 mm service cavity
service_plank.lighting: dimmable concealed 2700K wall wash; accessible ventilated driver
service_plank.end_modules: two accessible modules, each Indian 6A + USB-A + USB-C
service_plank.latest_condition: plank separated from sofa back and controls face upward

tv_wall.tv_latest_revision: centre raised 1 ft; current model records 5 ft screen centre
tv_wall.backing: full height to 10 ft ceiling; shifted 8.73 in / 220 mm right to clear W5 by modelled 61 mm
tv_wall.console: hidden ventilated service bays; current model 9.22 ft wide, older selected spec says 8 ft 6 in; final site-measured console must retain left edge at W5 centreline

ac_and_art.art: two botanical works using anti-glare acrylic

puja.envelope: 42 in wide x max 13.5 in deep x approx. 84 in high
puja.selection: P1 visual language with P3 flush side-pocket and tray operation
puja.door_operation: four narrow fluted toughened-glass leaves in brass/walnut frames; each side pair folds, pivots and retracts into a flush side pocket; no door leaf may obstruct hall or adjacent 32 in door path

diya_tray.construction: stone/non-combustible base, removable brass drip liner, raised oil lip, positive stops
diya_tray.interlock: opening tray opens shrine; closing shrine retracts tray first

fire_and_ventilation: permanent high and low ventilation in every door state
doors fully open and tray fully extended for diya/incense/dhoop
close only after every flame/ember is extinguished and lining has cooled
puja.hardware: manufacturer-rated synchronised pocket-fold hardware, adjustable guides/soft-close, and removable service access panel; full-size supplier mock-up mandatory

master.modelled_layout: 6 ft x 6 ft 6 in bed, bedside drawers, west wardrobe, TV storage and console
master.intent: clear floor, bedside controls, closed storage

bedroom_2.r011_revised_layout: TV unit replaced by a 5 ft x 1 ft 6 in study unit on the south wall (face 3 ft 9 in from bed foot); TV removed; AC moved from west wall to south wall over the unit; desk height and pedestal are assumptions (RFI-012)
bedroom_2.latest_approved_change: bed and both bedside tables shifted 538 mm toward east almirah
bedroom_2.rejected: inner-entry privacy screen was removed; do not re-add by default
bedroom_2.east_wall_run: R-010 (15 Oct 2026): 3 in offset + 1 ft 3 in oak end store + 10 ft 9 in wardrobe = 12 ft 3 in, as on the architect plan; store and wardrobe no longer overlap

bedroom_3.modelled_layout: 5 ft 6 in x 6 ft 3 in bed, bedside tables, east-wall run 2 ft 9 in wardrobe + 2 ft mirror store + 5 ft x 1 ft 9 in folding iron table + 1 ft 6 in shelf + 4 ft 3 in wardrobe; no TV

wet_utility_and_external.lobby: R-011: shoe rack 1 ft x 3 ft against the east wall from the lift-entry wall face; height and shelving assumed (RFI-012)
wet_utility_and_external.rear_shaft: R-011: kota/granite shelf 1 ft 9 in x 4 ft 3 in on the shaft west wall; height, slab and supports assumed; shaft status unchanged (RFI-011)
wet_utility_and_external.master_bath: anti-slip concept tile, vanity, mixer shower, concealed cistern, high window and washing-niche relationship
wet_utility_and_external.common_bath: retain 4 ft 6 in width; vanity, WC, shower, exhaust/high ventilation and external switch concept
wet_utility_and_external.washing_niche: washer, inlet tap, hose, switched outlet and shaft concept; site-confirm protected electrical circuit and plumbing
wet_utility_and_external.store: shelving retained; do not infer separate handwash from older model labels
wet_utility_and_external.lift_stair_terrace: visual concepts only; lift vendor and built stair govern; terrace requires separate waterproofing, slope, drain, parapet and weatherproof-electrical check
wet_utility_and_external.master_bath_R012: Shower 900 x 1,220 mm fully open (glass returns removed R-015), no border strip, flush back-wall linear drain over the architect drain point (outlet shift ~75 mm), falls away from walkway; 745 mm route to WC and washer, no longer separated from the shower; 25 L vertical geyser NW corner above vanity, underside 2,256 mm; floating vanity, WC sage upper cupboard, brass fittings (user-confirmed); towel bar and robe hooks on the east wall south of the shower line (R-016); 1 mm floor joints (R-015); grab-bar/seat blocking; washer marble top 610 mm with baskets; holds RFI-004/005/006/013

verified_current_conditions: kitchen has four burners and two recessed sink bowls
single lift-up chimney and drying-rack access doors
fixed reachable corner shelf; hidden RO and geyser configuration
no kitchen dining or separate handwash
W5-clear full-height TV panel and console aligned to its centreline
operable four-leaf puja closure and safe tray sequence
day/night, kitchen access, puja access and GLB-download controls checked
R-019 ledge modelled near sofa, flush to west wall, with kitchen-facing drawers; model clearances are conditional on site measure
limitations: Concept geometry, not fabrication drawing or BIM.
Visual lighting is not a measured lux design.
Vendor appliance dimensions, hood installation height, cabinet fixing and physical shutter clearances are provisional.
Puja runner rating, heat clearance, ventilation free area and door hardware require supplier drawings and site verification.
Wet-area/terrace waterproofing and drainage have not been designed by this model.
R-019 joinery, support, fixing and electrical feed require site/fabricator checks; GLB joinery is simplified geometry.

continuation_protocol: Read docs/PROJECT_HANDOFF.md, this JSON, studio-control/project-state.json and the current README/CHANGELOG before a design change.
Use plan-geometry.json and the architect PDF for geometry; renders do not override constructed layout.
Edit the one model in output/jaipur-home, rebuild affected walkthrough/GLB outputs, run focused checks and commit each coherent update to Git.
Record site/vendor holds clearly; a Git commit and concept model do not constitute construction approval.
